_comment: Registry of result campaigns. Every campaign entry declares where its raw zip lives, which agents/variant it contains, and where its derived eval-stats CSV and advantage parquet land. paper-metrics/scripts/_common.py reads this file; the module-level ENVS/AGENTS/ZIP_NAMES constants are derived from `default_campaign`, so the paper tables keep reproducing unchanged. To onboard incoming results (DDPG+BC, n-step TD, FQL, rejection sampling), add a campaign entry, drop the zip in data/zips/, build its eval stats with scripts/build_eval_stats.py --variant <tag>, and pass campaign=<name> to the loaders.
